startup_input_scope: Only fixed config/weights and five synthetic black frames are supplied before READY. No study frame or result is used to choose warmup count or readiness.
timing_scope: Preflight, startup and warm loop are measured separately. Wrapper cold_user_elapsed excludes interpreter/import and final summary write, explicitly named in its receipt. Parent additionally measures full subprocess launch-to-exit elapsed via perf_counter, including those costs but excluding post-run report building. A warm-loop <=5 second result cannot be described as a cold start, release-before availability, or live-broadcast success. Same local simulated input schedule, including extraction and validation.
output_contract: Keep generic glove candidates only in bound local sidecar. Standard response always mitt=null, visibility=unknown, pose=unknown; candidate/ambiguous -> unknown, no_candidate -> unavailable. No absence/catcher/intent claim.

cache_contract.cached_value: immutable serialized mapping; callers receive new mutable dictionaries
cache_contract.key: entire exact byte pair, not path, mtime or a hash-only shortcut
cache_contract.not_cached: images, model outputs, SHA verification results or failures

guards: Every existing source/media/receipt/artifact byte verification, extraction MD5+PTS+size+duration check, causal lookup, symlink check and response binding remains. No seeking change and no frame pre-extraction.
execution: Three sequential fresh subprocesses; same CV20 plan bytes, same code, same ten cutoffs and five black warmups. Each process starts with an empty mapping cache. No parallel local tests/model work during the timed commands.
retry_policy: Exactly one startup and one attempt per scheduled cutoff per run. No retries, replacement, skip, retuning or optional stopping. Startup failure counts ten not attempted; retain failures and continue other preregistered runs if runtime integrity is intact.
analysis: Report every run: planned/attempted/accepted/errors/not-attempted, <=5s fraction with planned denominator, publication median/min/max, startup and full command elapsed, output equality against CV20, worker exit. Descriptive variability only: repeated ten frames are not thirty independent samples. No CI, accuracy, full-PA, causal speed or live performance claim.
